5.title: Offer expiry enforcement
5.body:
**User story** — As a shopper, expired offers never apply, and an offer that expires while my cart is open is re-checked at checkout.

**Acceptance criteria**
- An offer past its `expires_at` is not applied.
- Expiry during an open cart is re-checked at checkout.
5.author: paul

comments.author: paul
comments.body:
**[em] · Q1 · open-cart expiry** — An offer that expires while the cart is open: re-checked at checkout, or honoured until checkout?
- (a) re-checked at checkout — recommended: the story says so
- (b) honoured until checkout
